questions.subject: physics
questions.question_text: A block of mass 9 kg lies on a frictionless horizontal surface. A force of 18 N is applied horizontally. What is the acceleration of the block?
questions.explanation:
### Scenario
Block on smooth horizontal surface

### Solution
Newton's 2nd law: a = F/m = 18/9 = 2 m/s²
(No friction, so net force = applied force)

### Steps
ΣF = ma → a = F/m = 18/9
a = 2 m/s²

### Scenario

### Solution
F = ma → a = 32/2 = 16 m/s²

### Steps
Apply F = ma
a = F/m = 32/2 = 16 m/s²

questions.subject: physics
questions.question_text: In an Atwood machine, masses 3 kg and 1 kg are connected by a light string over a frictionless pulley. Find the acceleration of the system. (g = 10 m/s²)
questions.explanation:
### Scenario
Atwood machine — two hanging masses

### Solution
Atwood formula: a = (m₁-m₂)g/(m₁+m₂) = 20/4 = 5 m/s²

### Steps
Net force = (m₁ - m₂)g = (3-1)×10 = 20 N
Total mass = m₁ + m₂ = 4 kg
a = (m₁-m₂)g/(m₁+m₂) = 20/4 = 5 m/s²

questions.explanation:
### Scenario
Atwood machine — two hanging masses

### Solution
Atwood formula: a = (m₁-m₂)g/(m₁+m₂) = 10/5 = 2 m/s²

### Steps
Net force = (m₁ - m₂)g = (3-2)×10 = 10 N
Total mass = m₁ + m₂ = 5 kg
a = (m₁-m₂)g/(m₁+m₂) = 10/5 = 2 m/s²

questions.question_text: Gun fires bullet. Find recoil velocity of gun given bullet speed. Mass = 8 kg, applied force = 55 N. V_gun = -mv/M by momentum conservation
questions.explanation:
### Scenario
Newton's third law — recoil

### Solution
F = ma → a = 55/8 = 6.9 m/s²

### Steps
Apply F = ma
a = F/m = 55/8 = 6.9 m/s²

questions.question_text: Object of mass m moves in circular path on inside of bowl. Find N. Mass = 8 kg, applied force = 36 N. N - mg = mv²/R (bottom), N = mv²/R + mg (inside loop)
questions.explanation:
### Scenario
Normal force on curved surface

### Solution
F = ma → a = 36/8 = 4.5 m/s²

### Steps
Apply F = ma
a = F/m = 36/8 = 4.5 m/s²

questions.question_text: Mass m hangs on spring (k). Find extension at equilibrium. Mass = 7 kg, applied force = 49 N. x = mg/k (Hooke's law)
questions.explanation:
### Scenario
Spring-mass equilibrium stretch

### Solution
F = ma → a = 49/7 = 7 m/s²

### Steps
Apply F = ma
a = F/m = 49/7 = 7 m/s²
